pageDescription: Automatically forward incoming SMS to a webhook or ServerChan (WeChat push), with configurable request parameters and one-click testing.
webhookUrlInvalid: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://
webhookUrlRequired: A webhook URL is required when forwarding is enabled
webhookTimeoutInvalid: Timeout must be an integer between 1 and 120
webhookHeadersPlaceholder: One per line, format: Name: Value (optional)
webhookHeadersInvalid: Header line {{line}} is invalid; expected Name: Value
webhookTemplatePlaceholder: Leave empty for the built-in payload: {"sender":…, "date":…, "text":…, "index":…, "storage":…}
webhookTemplateInvalid: The template is not valid JSON after placeholder substitution
webhookTemplateHint: Placeholders: {sender} {date} {text} {index} {storage}; values are JSON-escaped. GET requests send fields as query parameters, so the template only applies to POST/PUT.
webhookLoadFailed: Failed to load SMS forwarding configuration
webhookFooterHint: When enabled, the device sends new messages to this URL with the configured method and automatic retries; changes take effect immediately after saving.
serverChanSendKeyInvalid: SendKey cannot contain whitespace; sctp keys must look like sctp{digits}t…
serverChanSendKeyRequired: A SendKey is required when pushing is enabled
serverChanGetKeyHint: No SendKey yet? Register for free on the ServerChan website by scanning the WeChat QR code.
serverChanFooterHint: ServerChan pushes new messages to WeChat/WeCom and more (switch channels in its console) with automatic retries; the free tier allows 5 messages per day.
